summary: Iteration 10 — RazorpayX Payouts (Part B, backend only). 21 pytest cases written in /app/backend/tests/test_razorpayx_payouts.py covering driver GET/POST /payouts/bank-account (empty/masked view, missing_bank_fields, invalid_ifsc, invalid_account_number, invalid_vpa, valid bank_account, valid VPA, switching-clears-fund-account-id), GET /payouts/history (empty + seeded row with sensitive fields stripped), admin POST /admin/payouts/create validation (401 no-auth, amount_below_minimum, bank_account_not_saved, imps_requires_bank_account, upi_requires_vpa), admin happy path against RazorpayX test-mode (returned real pout_ id, persisted row, populated contact_id + fund_account_id, idempotent replay via client_action_id, /admin/payouts list, /admin/payouts/{id}/refresh), and webhook /webhooks/razorpayx (missing sig 400, wrong sig 400, valid HMAC-SHA256 with payout.processed updates status/utr, X-Razorpay-Event-Id dedup). 21/21 pass. Happy path reached RazorpayX (pout_ id received). No 5xx errors. No product bugs.
action_items: Non-blocking: convert class-scoped autouse teardown fixture in TestRazorpayxWebhook to @classmethod to silence pytest-10 deprecation warning (Class-scoped fixture defined as instance method). Cleanup still works because I use module-level pytest.<attr> stashes.

Non-blocking observation: /api/webhooks/razorpayx returns 503 webhook_not_configured only when RAZORPAYX_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty. The placeholder value 'ride91-rzpx-whsec-placeholder' in .env is non-empty, so the endpoint accepts test HMACs signed with that string. Main agent should replace with the real dashboard-issued secret before shipping to prod (test explicitly signs with the .env value, so the assertion is: 'whatever the .env secret is, must match the sender's HMAC').

Non-blocking: server.py:2601 does `row.pop('_id', None)` AFTER insert_one, but the response builds `{payout_id, status, razorpayx_id}` from local vars and never returns `row`, so the pop is dead code. Cosmetic.
critical_code_review_comments: Idempotency is correctly implemented on two axes: (a) our db.payouts unique index on client_action_id → server-side dedup returns {dedup:true} without a second RazorpayX call (verified); (b) X-Payout-Idempotency header on the outbound RazorpayX POST → protects even if our dedup layer is bypassed. Belt-and-suspenders, good.
Contact + Fund Account creation is lazy (server.py:2459) — no RazorpayX quota consumed for drivers who never receive a payout. Correct design.

Bank/VPA save invalidates razorpayx_contact_id AND razorpayx_fund_account_id (server.py:2427-2428), so switching destinations forces a fresh Fund Account on next payout. Verified with sentinel values in DB.
Webhook HMAC computed on raw body BEFORE json.loads (server.py:2646-2656) — correct order. Uses hmac.compare_digest → constant-time.

Dedup key is X-Razorpay-Event-Id (falling back to event.id, then hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() as last resort) with db.webhook_events unique index → the InsertOne exception path returns {ok:true, dedup:true}. Race-safe.
Payouts history strips razorpayx_fund_account_id and razorpayx_contact_id before returning to driver (server.py:2452-2453). Verified — sensitive fields don't leak.
IFSC regex `[A-Z]{4}0[A-Z0-9]{6}` matches the 4-letter bank code + '0' + 6-alnum branch scheme. Case-insensitive via .upper() (server.py:2370). Correct.
Amount minimum enforced at 100 paise (₹1) which matches Razorpay's minimum payout amount per their docs.
GET /admin/payouts/{id}/refresh doesn't fail if utr is null (server.py:2632) — uses .get() throughout. Robust.
Contact payload trims empty email/contact keys (server.py:2486) — RazorpayX rejects empty strings, so this is defensive and correct.

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21 RazorpayX payouts tests pass; RazorpayX test-mode API reachable, happy path returned real pout_ id)

seed_data_creation: Function-scoped `test_driver` fixture creates a TEST_-prefixed driver+vehicle+session in Mongo for each test. Teardown deletes drivers/vehicles/sessions/driver_bank_accounts/payouts for that TEST_ driver. Webhook test seeds its own synthetic TEST_ payout row (independent of the happy-path fixture) and cleans it via a class-scoped autouse fixture + a manual post-run sweep. Verified zero TEST_-prefixed rows remain in any collection after the suite finishes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RazorpayX Payouts (Part B) backend is production-ready for test-mode. The 503 razorpayx_not_configured branch on _rzpx_request was not exercised end-to-end because it requires restarting supervisor with empty keys — code-reviewed instead (server.py:2327-2328). If a future run drops RAZORPAYX_ACCOUNT_NUMBER from .env and restarts backend, all admin payout endpoints will return 503. Real-webhook signature verification against a live RazorpayX dashboard requires the user to replace RAZORPAYX_WEBHOOK_SECRET with the dashboard-issued value; our tests sign with whatever's in .env, so they don't validate against real RazorpayX-signed events (spec-inherent limitation). If Part C is the frontend/admin UI, the endpoints tested here are stable — safe to build against.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 21 spec cases pass; happy path actually reached RazorpayX and returned a valid pout_ id; DB state (payouts row, contact_id, fund_account_id, webhook status update) all persisted correctly.
